subject: Ghost click on portal acceptance flow - Coupa vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@heliomfg.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acceptance step appears to do nothing when clicking 'Accept'

Hi Ben,

We're in the middle of accepting the vendor setup for Helio Manufacturing in the Coupa supplier portal but when our finance user clicks the final 'Accept' button the UI shows a spinner for ~3s and then nothing happens — no confirmation, no redirect, button stays enabled. We've tried Chrome and Edge, cleared cache, and the same thing happens for two users in our org.

I attached a screenshot and a HAR export. The screenshot shows the final modal before clicking; the HAR was captured during the click. Can you help? We need the supplier record created so POs can flow.

Steps to reproduce (our side):
- Login as supplier admin (alex.gomez@heliomfg.com)
- Navigate to onboarding > claim tenant > complete forms > click Accept
- Observe spinner then no confirmation

Impact: blocking PO creation for an urgent shipment (PO 5342).

Thanks,
Alex Gomez
Vendor Operations
Helio Manufacturing

[Attachment: heliomfg_screenshot_20280712.png (image/png)]
[Attachment: browser_har_export_heliomfg.har (application/har+json)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@heliomfg.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance step appears to do nothing when clicking 'Accept'

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear repro and attachments. Sorry you're blocked. I'm looping in Marissa (runtime ops) and Jonas (integrations) to triage.

Immediate asks so we can prioritize:
- Can you confirm the supplier email used to claim the tenant (and whether it was a delegated admin)?
- Does the behavior reproduce in incognito with all extensions disabled?
- Approximate time you attempted the accept (timezone + timestamp) so we can correlate logs.

Marissa / Jonas: initial read of the HAR shows a 200 for the accept POST but a subsequent 500-ish trace coming from the identity bridge (we see relaystate params). My hypothesis: the frontend receives a success but the backend never writes the supplier record due to an aborted callback, leading to a silent UI fallback. If that's correct, we'll need to check the coupling between the Coupa webhook processing and our tenant claim worker.

I'll hold off asking the customer to retry until we confirm the nature of the failure.

-Ben
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

> On 2028-07-12 09:12, Alex Gomez wrote:
> > We're in the middle of accepting the vendor setup...
> > [Attachments omitted]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@heliomfg.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance step appears to do nothing when clicking 'Accept'

Thanks Ben — quick triage notes after looking at the HAR and checking the worker traces:

1) The frontend issues POST /api/onboard/accept -> 200 OK (body: {status: "queued"})
2) Our claim worker picks up the queue item and issues a call to /internal/identity/bridge/complete with RelayState and SAML assertion reference. We see an intermittent 504 from the identity bridge during the window Alex provided (2028-07-12T09:10-09:15 PDT).
3) When the bridge times out we currently mark the job as "retry" but do not surface a UX notification; the frontend only shows an optimistic UI path and assumes worker will succeed.

Action plan:
- Jonas, can you patch the worker to persist a transient failure state that surfaces to the UI (so vendor sees an error and retries) and add an extra retry/backoff for 504s?
- I'll open an incident with the identity bridge owners to escalate the 504s and get traces for 09:10-09:20.
- Ben, once we have a fix or mitigation we can ask Alex to retry; in the meantime I'll add a manual backfill for Helio to create the supplier record so PO 5342 isn't blocked.

Work items:
- [MCOLE] Raise bridge incident & collect traces
- [JWEBER] Worker change: persist transient failure + surface error to UI (estimate: 3-4 hrs)
- [BCARTER] Coordinate manual supplier creation and confirm with Alex the expected PO to unblock (PO 5342)

I'll update this thread with the incident ID and logs.

-Marissa
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

> On 2028-07-12 09:28, Ben Carter wrote:
> > I'm looping in Marissa (runtime ops) and Jonas (integrations) to triage.

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@heliomfg.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance step appears to do nothing when clicking 'Accept'

Thanks for the quick response and for the plan.

Confirming details you asked for:
- Supplier email used: alex.gomez@heliomfg.com (delegate admin: yes, invited via procurement@heliomfg.com)
- We reproduced in incognito with extensions disabled; behavior identical.
- Our original attempt time: 2028-07-12T09:09:24-07:00 (we recorded with the HAR).

We appreciate the manual backfill for the supplier record — that would unblock PO 5342. Please let me know what you need (I can re-run the acceptance once you tell us it's okay).

One more observation from our side: when the UI shows the spinner nothing appears in our browser console, which makes me think the frontend really did receive the queued response but the eventual backend callback failed. Happy to join a brief call if helpful.

Best,
Alex
Vendor Operations, Helio Manufacturing
